name: Sleevy
description: A native-first read-later service. Save any URL to a personal reading queue, then find, organize, and mark off what is in it. Sleevy stores and organizes links; it does not crawl pages or archive their content.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.1 authorization code with PKCE. Clients may register themselves through unauthenticated Dynamic Client Registration; a person then approves the requested scopes. See https://sleevy.app/auth.md.

scopes.saved-items:capture: Save a URL to the account's read-later queue.
scopes.saved-items:read: List and read the account's Saved Items.
scopes.saved-items:write: Update Saved Items, including read state and Folder assignment.
scopes.saved-items:delete: Delete Saved Items from the account.
scopes.folders:delete: Delete Folders while keeping their Saved Items.

apiKey.description: A personal API Key the person creates at https://sleevy.app/settings, for scripts and unattended clients.

skills.name: Save a link for later
skills.description: Save an HTTP or HTTPS URL to the person's reading queue. Saving a URL that is already saved updates it rather than creating a duplicate. Titles, images, and tags are fetched in the background, so they may be empty immediately after saving.
examples: Save https://example.com/an-article to my reading list
Add these five links to my Sleevy queue

skills.name: Find what is saved
skills.description: List or search the person's Saved Items, newest first, optionally restricted to one Folder. Results page with an opaque cursor.
examples: What is in my Sleevy reading list?
Show me the unread articles in my Research folder

skills.name: Track what has been read
skills.description: Mark a Saved Item read or unread, or record that the person opened it.
examples: Put this back in my unread queue

skills.name: Organize the queue into folders
skills.description: Create, rename, recolour, publish, and remove Folders, and move Saved Items between them. Removing a Folder keeps the Saved Items inside it.
examples: Make a folder called Research and move these links into it
